class.name: JRPGInputNumberCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: lets the player enter a number and stores it in a variable.
class.description: Asks the player for a number of [member digits] digits through the presentation port (a [code]"number"[/code] request starting from the variable's value, see [JRPGLocalPort]) and stores it in variable [member variable_id], kept within the digits asked for. Without an answer the variable stays as it is. Authority: both (it presents, and changes a variable).

members.member: How many digits the number has: 1 to [constant MAX_DIGITS].
The variable the number goes to.

constants.constant: The most digits a number can have.
